english.title: By act or omission, negligently interfered with resource or water main, a pipe, structure, installation or apparatus
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), by an act or omission, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT OR OMISSION..), negligently interfered with

(A)_[a resource main vested in]_
(B)_[a water main vested in]_
(C)_[a pipe vested in]_
(D)_[a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY STRUCTURE..), belonging to]_
(E)_[an installation, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTALLATION..), belonging to]_
(F)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..), belonging to]_

a water undertaker, namely **(..SPECIFY UNDERTAKER..), so as to damage it or so as to have an effect on its use or operation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(1)(b) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
by an act or omission negligently interfered with a resource main, a water main vested in or a pipe vested in
or a structure, installation or apparatus belonging to
a water undertaker, so as to damage it or so as to have an effect on its use or operation
